Application Data.NAME: Harmony Music Instruments LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Harmony Music Instruments LLC specializes in the sales and repair of a wide range of musical instruments, including guitars, pianos, brass, and woodwind instruments. Our business caters to musicians of all skill levels, offering both new and used instruments alongside professional repair and maintenance services. We provide personalized customer service and expert advice to ensure musicians find the right instruments for their needs. The business also hosts occasional workshops and events to foster a sense of community among local musicians.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/12/2022, a shipment of guitars was damaged in transit due to improper packaging, resulting in a loss of $3,000. The claim was processed and settled in August 2022 with the insurance company. On 08/20/2023, a customer's instrument was accidentally damaged during a repair, leading to a loss of $2,000. The customer was compensated and the matter is resolved.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras, motion sensor alarms, and a dedicated security guard during events.
